surface.$description: Page and slide background. Dark theme is a deep DGA navy, not black.

surface-subtle.$description: Alternating page bands, sidebars, table stripes.

surface-muted.$description: Input fills, image placeholders, quiet panels. ink-muted does NOT reach 4.5:1 here in light theme; use ink-secondary.

ink.$description: Primary text and headings on surface, surface-subtle and surface-muted. In light theme it is DGA navy, the site's main text colour.

ink-secondary.$description: Body copy in dense UI and article paragraphs, on surface and surface-subtle.

ink-muted.$description: Dates, captions, metadata; on surface and surface-subtle only (4.95:1 / 6.38:1).

line.$description: Hairline dividers and card outlines (decorative, not meaning-bearing).

line-strong.$description: Control borders (source value). Light #c1c1c1 is 1.8:1 on white, below the 3:1 floor for control borders: kept exact from dga.or.th; pair inputs with a label and the focus ring.

navy.$description: DGA navy (the 'A' of the logo). Footer, hero bands, cover and section-divider slides. Same in both themes.

on-navy.$description: Text and icons on a navy fill (16.6:1).

orange.$description: DGA orange, the brand colour (logo 'DG'). Fills, large headings 24px+ (3.54:1 on white), graphics, and text on navy (4.69:1). Never small body text on white.

orange-strong.$description: Primary buttons, links, active nav text, focus ring. Text on surface (4.53:1 light / 7.06:1 dark).

on-orange.$description: Label on an orange-strong fill (4.53:1 light / 7.06:1 dark).

orange-soft.$description: Tint behind active nav items and highlighted rows. Source pairs orange-strong text here at 4.22:1 (below 4.5:1 for 14.72px nav text): kept exact; bold 19px+ passes.

focus.$description: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 4.53:1 on white, 7.06:1 on dark surface.

link.$description: Inline links and 'อ่านต่อ' read-more links.

success.$description: Completed / on-track status. Always with a word or icon, never colour alone.

warning.$description: At-risk / pending status. Always with a word or icon.

danger.$description: Error / off-track. Keep visibly distinct from brand orange by pairing with an icon and the word.

chart-1.$description: First data series (navy). Charts in decks and reports.

chart-2.$description: Second data series / the highlighted series (orange).

chart-3.$description: Third series (navy tint). 3.46:1 on white, 5.27:1 on dark: fine for marks, label it directly.

chart-muted.$description: 'Other' / baseline / comparison bars. Carries no meaning on its own.

shadow-cta.$description: Hover on the primary orange button only.
